questions.q: In which comic did the Wasp debut in 1963?
questions.why: Tales to Astonish #44, from June 1963, introduced Janet van Dyne.

questions.q: What is the original Wasp's real name?
questions.why: Janet van Dyne is the original Wasp; Hope van Dyne is her daughter in the MCU.

questions.q: The Wasp gave which team its name?
questions.why: Janet was in at the start in 1963 and supplied the name of the Avengers.

questions.q: Besides flying on insect-like wings, what is the Wasp's main power?
questions.why: The Wasp can shrink and grow, fly with wings, and fire bio-electric blasts.

questions.q: Which actress plays Hope in the MCU Ant-Man films?
questions.why: Evangeline Lilly plays Hope starting in Ant-Man (2015).

questions.q: Which actress played the original Wasp in Ant-Man and the Wasp (2018)?
questions.why: Michelle Pfeiffer played Janet in the 2018 film.

questions.q: The Wasp divorced which fellow founding teammate in the 1980s?
questions.why: Janet divorced Hank Pym after he struck her.

questions.q: Which 2008 event saw the original Wasp presumed dead?
questions.why: Janet was presumed dead during Secret Invasion in 2008.

questions.q: What career did the original Wasp have in addition to being a superhero?
questions.why: Janet worked as a professional fashion designer.

questions.q: What was the name of the original Wasp's scientist father, killed by an alien entity?
questions.why: Vernon van Dyne was killed by an alien, which pushed his daughter to become the Wasp.
